answer_1.quote: We curate a Chinese dataset CRiskEval to evaluate LLMs by providing questions with four answer choices pertaining to behavioral tendencies of corresponding risk types and levels.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to risk-related questions, including multiple-choice selections and open-ended text.

answer_2.quote: We introduce two risk evaluation metrics for assessing the risk level of LLMs: Comprehensive Risk Indicator (CRI) and Specific Risk Indicator (SRI).

answer_4.quote: The models' response to each question was manually judged as one of the four risk levels.
answer_4.guideline: assigning responses to one of four risk levels: safe, neutral, moderately hazardous, extremely hazardous
